name: Pilot Accounting
description: Pilot provides bookkeeping, accounting, tax preparation, R&D credits, CFO advisory, financial reporting, accounts payable and receivable, and payroll support.
agentUseSummary: Pilot Accounting cannot currently be connected as a Relay agent provider because Pilot publishes no supported public account API, delegated OAuth contract, customer API key, remote MCP service, webhook schema, or distributable operation contract. Pilot's portal and finance-tool integrations bring bank, card, payroll, commerce, and accounting data into Pilot or grant its team access to third-party systems; they do not grant Relay authority over Pilot records. Relay will not reuse portal sessions, invite itself as an accountant, or infer private financial endpoints.

blocked.label: Connect Pilot Accounting
blocked.description: Pilot publishes no supported OAuth, customer API key, remote MCP, webhook, or other delegated Pilot-account contract for Relay to implement.

blocked.label: Access accounting or financial data
blocked.description: Transactions, bank and card data, ledgers, books, reconciliations, reports, invoices, bills, payroll, tax records, R&D claims, forecasts, budgets, models, messages, and customer documents are blocked without a supported authenticated API.

blocked.label: Perform accounting, tax, or payment actions
blocked.description: Categorization, journal entries, account changes, closes, bill pay, invoicing, payroll, tax and 1099 filings, R&D claims, financial models, and all other writes or submissions are blocked.

blocked.label: Use unsupported automation
blocked.description: Relay will not automate the Pilot portal, reuse browser sessions, invite itself as a QuickBooks accountant, capture bank credentials, scrape reports, reverse-engineer private endpoints, or relabel third-party integrations as a Pilot API.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported customer-authenticated Pilot API or remote MCP contract with stable schemas and least-privilege authorization.

runtimeSupport.description: No customer-authenticated Pilot Accounting operation is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No customer-authenticated Pilot Accounting operation is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Pilot documents a portal-based service combining accounting software, an AI accountant, and human finance teams, with inbound access to QuickBooks, banks, cards, Stripe, payroll, expense, commerce, and other tools. It publishes no Pilot account API, OAuth application contract, customer token, remote MCP service, webhook schema, stable operation schemas, sandbox, scopes, or revocation contract for independent third-party automation.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not expose Connect, request Pilot or bank credentials, invite Relay into QuickBooks, publish runtime tools, or automate the Pilot portal. Reconsider only if Pilot publishes a supported customer-authenticated API or remote MCP service with stable schemas, least-privilege read scopes, revocation, audit semantics, financial-data controls, and human confirmation for accounting, tax, payroll, and payment actions.

evidence.supports: Pilot documents portal communication, real-time company expense data, monthly P&L, balance-sheet and cash-flow reporting, transaction categorization, tax filings, R&D credits, CFO services, and integrations with customers' finance tools, but no public Pilot account API or delegated authentication contract.

Pilot instructs customers to invite Pilot as an accounting firm inside QuickBooks Online. This grants Pilot access to a third-party accounting system and is not a customer-authenticated Pilot API or authority that Relay can reuse.

Pilot states that it performs bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online and can prepare or hand off books, file included tax and 1099 deliverables, and migrate from Xero. These are service and third-party-system workflows, not published Pilot API operations.

Pilot describes an internal autonomous AI Accountant that runs onboarding through monthly close. It does not publish external authentication, tool schemas, scopes, or an API/MCP contract that Relay can mount.
